about: The re-audit of every code-built kind in data/inventory (PRD #10, the owner's order of work, 2026-10-18): keep as code, make by the prop pipeline, or code body + picture details, each with its reason and evidence; and the picture-made kinds that are big objects seen up close and need a code body. Judged by tools/props/library/CLAUDE.md (method B, sorter.py), the owner's rule of 2026-10-05/10-07 (code: plain plates, pipes and trims) and PRD #10's big-object rule.
